venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Closed (Sunday).** CC Atlanta does not operate on Sundays; no EON report is expected. Dark day, not an outstanding report.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 8/2 (MOD KE).** Net $1,265 vs target $1,538 (-17.8%). 49 guests, $25.81 check avg; comps $39 (3%). Rainy but pleasant temp. A pretty okay Sunday — most sales between 8:30-10pm when several groups of 4-10 came in, plus date nights, scattered two-tops, and the usual Opti/Oku folks. 86'd Taco Tuesday and Guinness. Favorite moment: guests hung out talking movies — guilty pleasures, horror, action, kids movies.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 8/2 (AM MJH / PM Carey & Lucas).** Net $9,253.30 vs target $9,661 (-4.2%). 162 guests (Tock); comps $215.70 (2.33%). AM $1,148.23, D&C PM $8,105.07, Garden/6A $1,647.92; food $2,243. Smooth Sunday — no real Toast hiccups. Garden very hot; Fro Spro machine slow to chill (note for openers: turn on at arrival on Garden days), no sales till ~4:30pm, then a couple pops. Kitchen chill with Dante, Lucas, Marv. No-shows charged. Favorite: Josh got a "best service I've ever received" comment.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 8/2 (MOD Thomas; Chef Kyler).** Net $4,257 vs target $3,820 (+11.4%). 152 covers, $28 check avg; comps $89.62 (over half member/investor). Food $178 (snacks only), beverage $4,080. Rainy Sunday, 'the most high energy lackadaisical is allowed to be' — a couple full-room moments with a short waitlist (~20 min). 3 large parties, 8 solos, 9 investor cocktails. Travelers from London, LA, Astoria; VIPs incl. members Kevin & Liz (Atlanta), Ashley (original DCLA GM) with shareholder partner Josh. Snacks-only kitchen clearly capped spend — MOD notes ponderous tables would've added drinks with food to pair. Top sellers: Burner Phone/Rosalie (tie), Dramatic Exit. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 8/2 (MOD Joe + Josh + Oscar).** Net $4,654 vs target $4,855 (-4.1%). 127 guests, $83.11 check avg; comps $129 (Matt Trujillo, Francisco, investor, birthday, DNL). Food $1,099; no SR. Smooth end to the week — opened with 50 covers, busiest hour 6-7pm, room full and lively from 8pm with a small fast-moving waitlist. Spread-out reservations made for well-paced service; mellow close. Kitchen smooth. No-shows charged. Favorite: Edwin making Ramos Gin Fizzes.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 8/2 (MOD Josh).** Net $2,007.47 vs target $1,864 (+7.7%). 44 guests; comps $20.84, voids $22. Food $140.40 (snacks only, extremely low dip). Note: a $3,817.63 Remy Cointreau invoice payment (Chicago Activation) was mis-rung through the POS and backed out — gross rang $5,825.10, true net $2,007.47. Heavy rain and lightning all evening; solid start then a long lull from ~6:45pm — cut host and closed a well. Nice 9pm push of walk-ins incl. industry birthday crew; held last call a bit. Garden closed. Quiet but smooth night.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Humid and hot, heavy afternoon/evening rain
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 8/2 (AM Justin & Lex / PM Braden & Marcus).** Net $5,741 vs target $6,500 (-11.7%). Comps $241; food $2,414. Splits: MB morning $553, MB evening $3,078, Sun Club $81, Hot Eye $854. Morning guest count 47 (OpenTable); evening count not reported. Very slow Sunday brunch, largely empty 1:30pm into happy hour. Evening slow with several no-shows; bar-only after 10pm. Storms shut Sun Club down from ~2pm — only 4 non-hotel guests; broke a grapefruit cheater. Hot Eye sleepy: 9pm bar crawl, then industry friends ~10:30. Kitchen: decent steak sales for the pace; 86'd stuffed peppers (restock tomorrow). Uneventful end to an eventful week.
